name: Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B

lineage.how_derived: two-stage training of a cross-encoder with a Pixtral vision encoder and a bidirectional Ministral3 tower

purpose: Multilingual and multimodal reranker for classical or agentic vision-RAG pipelines: scores a text query against a document given as text, page image or both (card).

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1
license.notes: LICENSE text read (the rerank repo carries it; the embed repos link the same OpenMDW-1.1): 'permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to deal in the Model Materials without restriction'; redistribution needs the agreement text and notices; rights end if you sue over patent or copyright infringement by the materials; no restriction on outputs. The Ministral-3 base models are Apache-2.0. Card tag 'other' with license_name openmdw-1.1 agrees.

architecture.kind: cross-encoder, Pixtral vision encoder plus bidirectional Ministral3 tower, relevance logit
architecture.why_this_design: Reads the page image together with the query instead of relying on OCR text; outputs one relevance logit per query-document pair (card).

variants.notes: use /classify in vLLM; /score and /rerank can mishandle image placeholders (card)

pc-16gb.notes: needs quantization; no quantized files seen

engine_support.notes: Pixtral vision encoder plus Ministral-3 text tower; no GGUF or llama.cpp support seen on the card (card documents vLLM 0.32 and transformers 5.20 only).

benchmarks.name: ViDoRe v3.1 Reranking leaderboard
benchmarks.score: state of the art as of 2026-10-20 (rank and number not on the card)

best_for: second stage after Nemotron-3.5-Embed on page images
soft.maturity: NVIDIA; released 2026-10-15; 8.4k downloads by 2026-11-19. No independent result or user report found.

tona_fit.reason: Permissive license and a leaderboard claim, but 16.75 GB BF16 fills a 16 GB card and no quantized or GGUF form exists; Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B is the practical choice for text and code.

open_questions: Actual ViDoRe v3.1 reranking score and rank
Independent evaluation and user reports: none found
